desc: Identify that for a fixed distinguished value, choosing a suffix subset of size \(k\) yields multiplicity \(k!(N-1-k)!\), and its digit shift is \(10^{\text{suffix digit total}}\).
Reduce fixed-value suffix enumeration to coefficients of \(\prod_{y\ne x}(1+10^{\operatorname{digits}(y)}t)\), with factorial weights by coefficient degree.
Derive and implement an \(O(N\log N)\) NTT method for \(P(t)=\prod_d(1+10^d t)^{c_d}\), and compute quotients via coefficient recurrence.
Aggregate contributions for each digit-length class using arithmetic-series value sums.
Validate the implementation against all public samples.
